name: Calculate geometric measurements and spatial properties
description: Users asked to calculate geometric properties such as volume, surface area, perimeter, and area for various shapes, including cones, cylinders, spheres, and polyhedra, often involving unit conversions or applied scenarios like filling pools or covering walls. The requests also included specific problems on spatial packing, ray tracing, coordinate scaling, and basic unit or coordinate conversions.
